Sandbox_MissionsEvents_EnableMod_tooltip: Enables or disables the entire Missions and Events system on the server (Pager item menu)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M1_Enable_tooltip: Enables or disables the zombie horde event (Event 1)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M1_Zombies_toolti: Minimum and maximum number of zombies spawned during the event (recommended over 30 and under 80, some may not spawn)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M1_Cooldown_toolt: Time before the zombie event can be activated again
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M1_Rewards_toolti: Items given as reward for completing the zombie event (comma separated). A backpack spawns with the horde
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_Enable_tooltip: Enables or disables the item collection event (Event 2). Items are always the same per category
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_Carpentry_tool: Allows the carpentry mission to appear in Event 2 (if both are enabled, selection becomes random)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_Electrician_to: Allows the electrician mission to appear in Event 2 (if both are enabled, selection becomes random)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_Duration_toolt: Time in minutes the player has to complete the mission before failing (once started, it must be completed before starting another mission). Recommended: 550+ minutes (≈ 1 real hour)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_Cooldown_toolt: Waiting time in hours before Event 2 can be started again (e.g. 30 in sandbox = 1 real hour)
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_RewardsCarpent: Items given as reward in the carpentry mission (max backpack capacity: 18; items must not exceed this limit). The bag is dropped on the ground
Sandbox_MissionsEvents_M2_RewardsElectri: Items given as reward in the electrician mission (max backpack capacity: 18; items must not exceed this limit). The bag is dropped on the ground
